verdict.rationale: Statsig documents an official MCP server that lets AI tools like Claude Code and Cursor "explore experiments, and access your Statsig data". It also offers a Console API that performs console actions programmatically and a CLI for managing experiments, so an agent can read experiment configurations. Experiments report metric lifts with confidence intervals, which gives an agent the raw material for ship/rollback summaries, but no item explicitly says results or scorecards can be fetched through the API or MCP. missing for 10: explicit documentation of programmatic access to experiment results/scorecard data, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), documented ship/rollback decision endpoints, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven result analysis.
